unit: parent-specific remarriage report, respondent age, step-parent status and conditional death timing
value_labels: A11 covers remarriage after parental divorce; A12 covers remarriage after a biological parent's death. Exact age and age band are alternatives; step-parent alive status gates death timing.
value_label_status: official divorce/death branches, conditional age ranges and step-parent routes reviewed; release coding requires QA
mapping_status: candidate metadata mapped to official 2014 Life History Codebook; not analysis-ready
caveat: Keep remarriage after divorce distinct from remarriage after bereavement and preserve maternal/paternal branches. Exact age and age band are not separate events. Step-parent death year/age are conditional. The questionnaire treats long-term cohabitation as marriage; no skipped field is recoded as No. 2014 special Life History survey; retrospective self-report. The official release note states that no weight is provided. Do not pool into regular-wave weighted pairwise analyses without a separately justified target population and linkage/design plan.

concept_label: Sibling deaths before age six and family relationship context

value_labels: B1 counts siblings who died before age six. Repeated B2 fields identify the sibling relationship, age at death, age gap, and same/different parentage; free-text cause of death is not included.
value_label_status: official questionnaire loops, fields and B1=0 route reviewed; authorized-release slot storage requires QA
mapping_status: candidate metadata mapped to official 2014 Life History Codebook; not analysis-ready
caveat: B2 loops over deaths before age six and is conditional on B1>0; B1/B2 describe sibling/family adversity, not respondent death or a sibling mortality rate. Do not use open-text cause-of-death responses, infer No from absent loop slots, or treat repeated sibling slots as independent exposures. 2014 special Life History survey; retrospective self-report. The official release note states that no weight is provided. Do not pool into regular-wave weighted pairwise analyses without a separately justified target population and linkage/design plan.

value_labels: Questionnaire activity options cover work, inactivity, illness, childbirth, family care, leisure/travel, training, incarceration and other. The gap questions are routed when the interval between repeated same-stage education episodes exceeds seven months.
value_label_status: official questionnaire gap definitions and Codebook repeated-slot identities reviewed; category storage and route-specific missingness require QA
mapping_status: candidate metadata mapped to official 2014 Life History Codebook; not analysis-ready
caveat: These describe activities during recalled gaps between same-stage education episodes, not general life history or independent causal exposures. Repeated episode slots are nested and not independent; preserve stage and route. Other is not interpreted; open-text details and Codebook frequencies are excluded. 2014 special Life History survey; retrospective self-report. The official release note states that no weight is provided. Do not pool into regular-wave weighted pairwise analyses without a separately justified target population and linkage/design plan.
